sections.label: TSD

sections.label: Radios

fields.label: Waypoints
fields.help: Navigation points and hazards (TSD > POINT > WPTHZ). Sequence 1..50, shared by waypoints (W) and hazards (H): W03 and H03 cannot both exist. Route waypoints map here: sequence = 1..n in route order (max 50), PointType "WP", Identifier "WP" (or SP for the first, RP for the last, LZ for landing zones, CC for comm checks), Hazards as PointType "HZ". Name is not uploaded (kneeboard only), no length limit; Free (max 3 uppercase alphanumerics) is shown on the TSD next to the point, so a 3-char short name of the route point is a good fit. Keep the list sorted by Sequence (the uploader walks slots up to the last element's sequence); sequences must be unique within the list. A new point in the app gets PointType "WP", Identifier "WP", Name "STPT <seq>". Jet ids: W01..W50 (waypoints) / H01..H50 (hazards).

fields.label: Sequence
fields.help: Point number, 1..50, unique within this list. Typed into the jet as W01..W50 (waypoints) / H01..H50 (hazards).

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Required by the editor (non-empty). Not uploaded to the Apache: only shown in DCS-DTC and on the generated kneeboard. Use the route point name.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "N 42°10.583’" (U+00B0 degree, U+2019 minute mark). Converted to 8-digit MGRS (10 m, truncated) when uploaded.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths with 3-digit zero-padded degrees, e.g. "E 042°28.950’".

fields.label: Elevation
fields.help: Feet MSL, 0..59999 in the editor. Typed into the ALT field. Use the route point ground/terrain elevation (not the flight altitude).

fields.label: Time over point
fields.help: HH:MM:SS or null. Not uploaded: only printed on the kneeboard (Waypoints list). Fill from the planned route TOT/ETA.

fields.label: Target
fields.help: Shows "TGT" in the list only; not uploaded. Leave false (route target points belong in the Targets list).

fields.label: Point type
fields.help: Required. Allowed in this list: WP, HZ. An unknown value makes the uploader and kneeboard throw; a type not offered by this list crashes the edit dialog.

fields.label: Control Measures

Keep the list sorted by Sequence (the uploader walks slots up to the last element's sequence); sequences must be unique within the list. A new point in the app gets PointType "GC", Identifier "CP", Name "STPT <seq>". Jet ids: C51..C99.

fields.label: Routes
fields.help: One entry per enabled route (the UI checkbox adds/removes it); at most one entry per Code. A planned route maps to one entry, typically Code 0 (Alpha), Mode 3 (UseSpecific) with Waypoints = the Waypoints-list sequences in fly order (control measure sequences 51..99 may be mixed in), or Mode 1 (UseAll) + IncludeAllWaypoints for "every WP in list order". Targets cannot be in routes. Upload with Upload.Routes.

fields.label: Route
fields.help: RouteCode: the RTM route letter (A B D E H I L O R T; no C/F/G).

fields.label: Points
fields.help: RouteMode. UseAll: every point selected by the IncludeAll* flags, in list order. UseRange: Waypoints = [from] or [from, to], inclusive over both Waypoints and ControlMeasures sequences (missing "to" = 50); a null/empty list throws in the uploader. UseSpecific: Waypoints = sequences in fly order, looked up in Waypoints first then ControlMeasures, unknown ones skipped. A route ticked but never edited has 0 and uploads empty.

fields.label: Point numbers
fields.help: null for UseAll; [from] or [from, to] for UseRange; ordered unique sequences for UseSpecific (UI text "1,2,3,51"). Built from the route: the Waypoints-list sequence numbers assigned to the route points, in order.

fields.label: Point number

fields.label: Laser codes
fields.help: Object keyed by code letter (A-H, J-N, P-R; an "I" property exists in the class but is never shown or uploaded). Each property has DefaultValueHandling.Ignore with default "", so unset letters are simply absent ({} when none). Writing "" is also accepted.

fields.label: Code
fields.help: 4-digit laser PRF code as a string, e.g. "1688". The UI only accepts codes inside allowedRanges (and keep digits 2-4 in 1..8); loading does not validate and the uploader types any 4 characters.

fields.label: Presets
fields.help: COM presets 1..10 (null when none). Each preset carries one frequency per radio. A preset is removed by the UI when all 6 frequencies are empty.

fields.label: Preset #
fields.help: Preset number 1..10, unique. Required (constructor parameter).

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Callsign/unit id, null for none. Upper-cased and trimmed by the uploader; if character 4 is a space ("ATC KUTAISI") the first 3 chars go to the unit id field and the rest (max 8) to the callsign, otherwise the first 8 chars go to the callsign. KU characters only (A-Z 0-9 . space - + / *).

fields.label: Frequencies
fields.help: Exactly 6 strings, by radio: [0] UHF 225.000-399.975, [1] VHF 118.000-151.975, [2] FM1 30.000-87.975, [3] FM2 30.000-87.975, [4] HF1 3.000-29.999, [5] HF2 3.000-29.999. "" for an unset slot. The uploader indexes [0]..[5] without a bounds check, so never write fewer than 6.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: Invariant-culture decimal with 3 fraction digits in 0.005 steps (e.g. "251.000", "5.500"), or "". Range depends on the index (see Frequencies).

fields.label: Selected channel per radio
fields.help: One entry per radio whose selection is set, matched by Number (order irrelevant): 1 UHF, 2 VHF, 3 FM1, 4 FM2, 5 HF1 (HF2 has no selected mode). Entries in Frequency mode with empty frequency and preset are dropped on save/read. null when none.

fields.label: Radio
fields.help: Radio index.

fields.label: Selected frequency
fields.help: Manual frequency for this radio ("" for none), same format and per-radio band as the preset frequencies.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: RadioMode: 1 Frequency (manual), 2 Preset.

fields.label: Selected preset
fields.help: Preset number as a string "1".."10", or "". Parsed with int.Parse by the uploader, so it must be numeric when non-empty.
